title: Creating a team
description: How to add a team from the Teams screen, what each field on the Add Team dialog does, and where the new team appears.
body:
You create a team from the Teams screen. It takes a name and a team size, and you own whatever you create.

Before you start

Your account already owns two teams. Scoryboard makes them when you sign up, named after you. The Teams screen is never empty.

Add a team

  1. Open Teams in the sidebar. Select Add Team.

  2. Read the note under the title. A team name must be unique, and it must not already belong to somebody else.

  3. Type a Team name.

  4. Open Team size and choose one. Sizes run from 5 VS 5 to 11 VS 11.

  5. Select Upload team's Avatar to add a crest. You can skip this and add one later.

  6. Leave both checkboxes clear. They make two special kinds of team, and neither is what you want for an ordinary one.

  7. Select Add.

  8. Find the new team at the foot of your list. You are its Owner.

What you will see

Each row on the Teams screen carries the team's size, your role in it, and how many leaderboards, matches and members it has.

A new team has one member: you.

If it does not work

  • "This field is required" under Team size. Team size has no default. The 5 VS 5 you can see is placeholder text, not a choice. Open the list and pick one.
  • The name is refused. Somebody else already owns a team with that name. Choose a different one.
  • The crest will not upload. Use a JPG, GIF or PNG under 3MB.
